events.title: George Black Cable Ferry, Dawson City
events.thought: The George Black ferry at Dawson City — a cable ferry across the Yukon, running on river current alone.
events.photoCaption: The George Black cable ferry crosses the Yukon River at Dawson City, fall birch turning yellow on the far bank.
